messages.text: Group and crossmatch status on record TRF-12?

Record TRF-12 shows the patient is blood group O negative with a positive antibody screen for anti-K, so K-negative units are required. Two units are currently crossmatched and valid, and the last haemoglobin before transfusion was 64.
